name: IEC multiplexer (MUX)
summary: IEC MUX element whose select inputs, grouped with G dependency, pick which data input reaches the output.
description: The IEC multiplexer carries the MUX qualifier. Select inputs are drawn with a binary grouping bracket producing G0 to Gn, and each data input is labelled with the matching number, so the data input whose number equals the select value is ANDed through to the output. An EN input, often active low, enables the whole element.

Multiplexers on control drawings route one of several signals to a shared output, for example selecting a measurement channel or an operating mode source. The binary grouping makes the select range clear without drawing a decoder.
The symbol does not state the switching time or whether outputs glitch during a select change. Those are device timing considerations.
readingNotes: Read the binary grouping to find the select range.
Each data input number matches a G value.
drawingChecklist: Show select inputs with a binary grouping bracket.
distinction: The analogue multiplexer passes analogue levels through switches; the logic MUX passes logic states.
